name: Potatoes Fried Whole
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Boil the potatoes until almost done. Drain.
If desired, dip the potatoes in flour, then egg yolks, then breadcrumbs.
Heat the drippings in a pan. Add the potatoes, and fry until brown and crisp, shaking regularly to prevent burning.
Remove from pan, and serve hot.
